name: Gibraltar
note: British territory; no polygon in the Natural Earth base map. Port code GIGIB is in the searoute list.

name: Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba
note: Caribbean Netherlands; no polygon in the base map. ANKRA (Kralendijk, Bonaire) is in the searoute list; the plan expected no port.

name: Christmas Island
note: Australian territory; no polygon in the base map. Port code CXXCH is in the searoute list.

name: Tokelau
note: New Zealand territory of three atolls; no polygon in the base map and no port in the searoute list (TKMRW there is Turkmenbashy, not Tokelau).

name: Asia, not specified
note: Not a place: BACI code S19 'Other Asia, n.e.s.' for the exports that the atlas does not read as Taiwan (see pipeline/trade/clean.py). No coast, no port: its flows are seaborne by assumption and not routed.
